about_the_game:
Dream-Chasing Window Cleaner x Action-Adventure

Experience a thrilling action-packed adventure as a window cleaner navigating the towering skyscrapers of the city.

Chase your dreams, face harsh realities, and carve out Sky’s future.

Thrilling Cleaning Action

Utilize wires and skills to swiftly and precisely clean buildings.

But be careful—one slip could lead to a deadly fall. Overcome hazards like birds, lightning strikes, strong winds, and many many more as you aim for top performance.

Manage Your Money and Well-being

Taxes, rent, medical bills—survive day by day while managing your limited income.

Overworking takes a toll on your body. Rest and entertainment are key to maintaining balance in your daily life.

Upgrade Skills & Equipment

Enhance your cleaning tools and unlock abilities through the Skill Synapse skill tree.

Build the optimal setup and clean more efficiently.

Sky’s Life Changes with Your Choices

The story unfolds across five different scenarios, each with unique characters and settings.

Overcome challenges, interact with people, and help Sky find his true path.

—If you reach for the sky, one day you’ll touch it.

Shape Sky’s future with your own hands.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 LTS or SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7870, OpenGL 3.3 compatible
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS or SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 570, OpenGL 4.5 compatible
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: SKY THE SCRAPER is an action-packed adventure about Sky, a young man who pursues his uncertain dreams while working as a building window cleaner. Through exciting wire action and daily life management, endure two months of hard living and pave the way for Sky's future.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
